text: My cabin: C-73. Ring the bell by the door to call Smethells.
The trunk key is in my bag on the bed.
My trunk: a cryptograph for German codes and a report on the international situation.
Penny Pringle: cabin F-34, F deck. Use the second-class stairs.
The Purser can give any passenger's cabin number. Office: left, before the C deck cabins.
Lifts: behind the forward Grand Staircase.
The Burnses: cabin C-78. Mr. Burns has a darkroom there; look at his pictures.
Mr. Barbicon: cabin A-14. Vlad wants his package; say you come from Vlad.
Mr. and Mrs. Conkling: cabin B-59.
Lord and Lady Georgia: stateroom B-70.
Colonel Zeitel: cabin C-59.
Shailagh Hacker: third class, cabin F-59, forward.
Claris Limehouse and her mother: cabin D-19, near Reception.
Buick Riviera is never in his cabin; he gambles in the smoking room.
Charles gave the real necklace to Sasha. It's in Sasha's cabin.
Willie hid a notebook somewhere on board.
At Queenstown Willie was seen at the top of the last smokestack, hiding something.
The only way into the smokestack is through the engine room.
A motorcar is in the cargo hold. Whoever shows the car keys is let through.
Cargo room: forward past the Well deck, under the Forecastle deck.
The Purser's cargo manifest shows where the crate is. He may have keys to the hold.
Get into the wireless room and intercept Zeitel's telegrams.
Wireless room: boat deck, port side, just astern of the bridge.
Leave the Rubaiyat with the Purser for safekeeping.
Something's up at the Turkish bath.
Willie Haderlitz is dead, electrocuted in the Turkish bath.
Trask: the pipe has been somewhere humid. Steam up the Turkish bath.
Trask: read the full verse; completing it gives the answer.
Squash court: entrance on D deck. Willie waits there.
Gymnasium: boat deck, starboard side.
Café Parisien: aft past the B deck cabins, at the aft Grand Stair landing.
A deck has been complaining about the lights; Alex is seeing to the fusebox.
Conkling: meet Shailagh on the poop deck in his place. No trouble if she returns the letter.
The Purser wants a message taken to the wireless room.
Penny thinks Zeitel hid the notebook in his cabin, C-59.
Zeitel will trade the antidote for the painting.
Zeitel: Lady Georgia is in Sasha's cabin, A-14.
Lady Georgia: meet her on the boat deck, with the necklace.
Claris Limehouse is in the First-Class lounge.
Trask: show Willie's ring to the pretty girl he knows. She'll help.
Penny: ask Trask about the clue and about Willie's ring.
Trask wants to meet me where Honor and Glory crown Time.
Willie's phrase, via Jack Hacker: 'But still the Vine her ancient Ruby yields... a Garden by the Water blows'.
Willie quoted an old book: 'Only one thing is certain, and the rest is lies.'
Trask on the verse: 'her ancient Ruby' means something red and old.
Trask: search the Café Parisian. It's a 'Garden by the Water'.
Trask: 'many knots unraveled by the Road' may mean Scotland Road on E deck, or a rope.
Troutt: Willie mixes with steerage; he visited a young woman's room in third class, F deck.
Smethells: Willie argued on B deck with a stranger about a painting he'd misplaced.
Morrow: ask Smethells, Willie's steward. Willie came to the bath after the squash courts.
Decoded drop location: the boiler rooms. There's an entrance to the lower decks nearby.
Penny: the Serbian Vlad may have the notebook.
Zeitel and Willie spend their time in the Café Parisian.
Willie: Zeitel's telegram was delayed at the wireless; too many messages.
Penny: Zeitel's contact on board is the London art dealer Sasha Barbicon.
Mr. Burns photographed Zeitel; he may have a picture of Zeitel with Barbicon.
Penny: Zeitel and Sasha are arguing at the ship's stern. Listen in.
Penny: the painting is what Zeitel is really after. Secure it.
Zeitel: Willie misplaced a painting bound for the German Embassy, a Viennese street scene.
Cargo hold guard: a young German took a painting out of the hold.
Penny: leave the painting with the Purser, with the Rubaiyat.
Penny's pen lets out one burst of knock-out gas when opened.
Sasha handed over Vlad's things. Take them to Vlad.
Gorse-Jones: an immigrant on the second-class stairwell was carrying a painting.
Zeitel is waiting for me in the lounge.
Zeitel poisoned Lady Georgia. He has the antidote and wants something from me.
Zeitel: there's a bomb on the sofa.
Zeitel will trade the painting and its plans for the boat pass.
Lady Georgia wants to meet me. She's outside on the A deck promenade.
Lady Georgia is out on the poop deck, away from her husband.
Lady Georgia gave me her necklace to keep. Don't tell Charles or Sasha; she told Charles it's with the Purser.
Lady Georgia: visit her stateroom while Charles has his drink in the smoking room.
The diamond necklace Georgia wears is a fake.
Georgia: Sasha ran below toward the turbine room to fetch his valuables.
Daisy: Andrew Conkling has been asking for me.
Conkling: his former maid Shailagh Hacker stole a letter. He wants it back.
Conkling: speak to Shailagh without her brother.
The Hackers want $5,000 from Conkling for the letter. Meet them there again at one tonight.
Purser: for Jack Hacker, ask his sister, Miss Hacker.
Mrs. Conkling took Shailagh's baby to first class. Trade her the letter for him.
Jack Hacker has the painting Willie gave him. He'll hand it over once the baby is back.
Get the baby to his mother and off the ship before the last boat.
Daisy wants the name of a man with initials G-Q-C. The Purser has a passenger list.
G-Q-C is Mr. George Quincy Clifford.
Daisy wants a boat with the 'best' people, the Astors. They were in the gymnasium.
The Carters keep their motorcar keys with the Purser.
Buick plays blackjack for a lifeboat pass. He'll take a necklace or a book as my stake.
Riviera is playing for very high stakes and cutting deals. Play him a hand.
The Purser wants Mr. Straus's lost gold cufflink found. Give it to the Purser.
Burns will trade his photos for a gift for Stephanie. Maybe ask Reverend Troutt.
Alex left the A deck fusebox to fetch his screwdriver from below.
Penny: Smethells was looking for me.
Officer Morrow: on the boat deck near the bridge.
Officer Morrow has misplaced his binoculars.
Morrow lets me into the wireless room; the operators went for coffee.
Bridge: controls for the watertight doors between the boiler and engine rooms.
Engineer won't let me pass while his panel runs rough: get the turbine needle into the green zone.
The ship is sinking: about an hour left, maybe a little more.
The boat pass gets me a seat in a lifeboat.
Boats two and four are the last; they wait for Officer Morrow.
Come back in a few minutes; there may be room in a boat.
Burns begs for a pass or anything to get Stephanie into a boat.
Vlad must board a lifeboat unnoticed; in disguise he could reach the boats.
Turkish bath: lift to D deck, doors beneath the stairs, down three flights.
Smoking room: A deck, outside aft to the aft Grand Staircase; doors nearest the stern.
Poop deck: second-class stairs to B deck, outside aft past the third-class promenade.
Boiler and engine rooms: second-class stairs down to F deck, then stairs down from there.
Scotland Road: E deck, stern to bow. Reach it from second class, through the doors behind Troutt.
Third class: head forward down Scotland Road, then take the stairs down.
